title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-p19p: C_R missing from context_2 (RFC 9528 Section 5.3)
description: RFC 9528 Section 5.3 requires context_2 = (C_R, ID_CRED_R, CRED_R) for EDHOC Method 3. Both Python (edhoc.py lines 407, 604) and Rust (edhoc.rs lines 442-447, 468-476) construct context_2 as (ID_CRED_R, CRED_R) — omitting C_R. In Rust, `build_context_2` accepts `_c_r` as parameter (intentionally unused, with underscore prefix). This weakens MAC_2 binding by not including the responder's connection identifier in the MAC computation context.
